fusions.name: One Good Skip
fusions.desc: Skims a link at the first enemy it meets for 4 damage; it skips on to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

fusions.name: Shaken Spray
fusions.desc: Shakes water off your chains in a cone, which deals 26 damage that ignores resistances to everything within 4 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shrugged Off
fusions.desc: Removes up to 5 conditions from you, and you move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolls Right Off
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions lifts, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
